info.title: Dolina ASPM API
info.description: API for the Dolina Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) system. Enables ingestion of security scanner reports, management of application components, and retrieval of unified security analysis reports.

tags.name: CLI
tags.description: Methods user by a Dolina CLI module

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
- ANALYSIS_STATE_NOT_STARTED: analysis job in a queue
 - ANALYSIS_STATE_ASSIGNED: worker is assigned
 - ANALYSIS_STATE_IN_PROGRESS: worker is processing
 - ANALYSIS_STATE_VERIFICATION: worker is verifying and sends analysis results
 - ANALYSIS_STATE_DONE: analysis is done and results are saved
 - ANALYSIS_STATE_ERROR: analysis is finished with error
 - ANALYSIS_STATE_TIMEOUT: analysis is finished with timeout
 - ANALYSIS_STATE_CANCELED: analysis is cancel by user

post.description: Forces all active analysis windows into closed state and immediately starts them, setting the priority to the max available values
Cancels analysis window start, if its not started yet
Forces an active analysis window into closed state and immediately starts it, setting the priority to the max available value

parameters.description: Contextual metadata accompanying a raw scanner report. It provides information about the environment in which the scan was executed, such as the repository URL, Git reference (branch, tag, commit), pipeline or build ID, and any other relevant deployment or runtime context. This data is used by Dolina ASPM to enrich, filter, and correlate findings with specific code versions or build stages.

Includes identifiers (ID/UUID), naming information, version details, component inventories (libraries, modules, services), ownership metadata, deployment characteristics, and audit timestamps for tracking application security posture.

labelList.title: user-defined text labels to categorize applications, e.g. backend/frontend and others

v1Asset.description: Technical entity associated with an application, such as source code, container image, build artifact, dependency package, or other deployable component. Includes identification, type, version or digest, source reference, ownership metadata, and timestamps for tracking inventory, traceability, and security analysis within the ASPM system.
v1Asset.title: Asset

maskedSegmentsList.title: hidden segments offsets (also for secret masking)

v1CodeFragment.description: Source code fragment representation capturing vulnerable code snippets, secrets, or defects within files. Contains line numbers (start/end ranges), extracted code content, surrounding context lines, file path reference, and metadata about the detected issue type, severity, and detection source for remediation tracking in the ASPM system.
v1CodeFragment.title: Code fragment

parentHashes.title:
merge commit genealogy, parent commit hashes (for merge commits),
identifies which commits were merged together to create this revision

committedAt.title: exact commit timestamp from the vcs

v1Commit.description: Git commit metadata extracted for security analysis and audit. Contains exact VCS identifiers and authorship for precise historical reconstruction and vulnerability attribution.
v1Commit.title: Git commit

isPublic.title: if component was obtained from public sources (npm, github etc.)

v1Component.description: A software component that is part of an application's architecture.Components can include libraries, frameworks, services, containers or other artifacts. Each component tracks metadata such as name, version, type, and security‑relevant attributes like vulnerabilities, licenses, and dependencies. In Dolina ASPM, components are the primary units for assessing and managing application security posture.
v1Component.title: Component

appliedRiskScore.title: applied risk score is based on inputs from security scanners and applied ruleset

applicationRef.title: git ref of an application to define where defect was found

v1Defect.description: Represents a security defect (vulnerability) identified and tracked within Dolina ASPM. This is the primary entity for managing vulnerabilities, containing enriched information including custom ASPM status, references (e.g., CVE, CWEs), known exploits, an activity log for audit trail, and various internal metadata generated by the ASPM engine during analysis and remediation workflows.
v1Defect.title: Defect

v1DefectStatus.title:
- DEFECT_STATUS_INDIRECT: defect is indirect for scanner application
 - DEFECT_STATUS_DIRECT: defect is found directly in a scanned application
 - DEFECT_STATUS_DEV_ONLY: defect is found in development-only (workspace) runtime package
 - DEFECT_STATUS_CI_ONLY: defect is found in pre-deploy steps
 - DEFECT_STATUS_FIXED_BY_UPDATE: defect is removed by library/package update
 - DEFECT_STATUS_WILL_NOT_FIX: defect is purposely left in code by distributor
 - DEFECT_STATUS_END_OF_LIFE: defect is found in no longer supported (EOL) package
 - DEFECT_STATUS_HAS_EXPLOIT: defect has known exploit

v1DefectType.title:
- DEFECT_TYPE_SAST: static source code analysis defects
 - DEFECT_TYPE_SECRETS: found secrets (api keys, passwords) in source code or on host
 - DEFECT_TYPE_DAST: dynamic testing (dast) defects
 - DEFECT_TYPE_FUZZING: dynamic testing (fuzzing) defects
 - DEFECT_TYPE_MAST: mobile dynamic testing defects
 - DEFECT_TYPE_PENTEST: penetration testing defects
 - DEFECT_TYPE_OSA: defects found in open source packages
 - DEFECT_TYPE_SCA: software composition (packages and libraries) defects
 - DEFECT_TYPE_IAC: infrastructure as code configuration file defects (Dockerfiles, Terraform, Helm and others)
 - DEFECT_TYPE_ARCH: insecure architecture defect
 - DEFECT_TYPE_CODE_REVIEW: security defect during code review

v1Exploit.description: Represents a security exploit with identifying information, description, and external references. Contains a unique identifier (UUID), title, detailed description, list of reference URLs to external resources (CVE, exploit databases, etc.), and optional creation/update timestamps for audit tracking.
v1Exploit.title: Exploit

fileName.title: file_name is later will be processed into unique file key

useVersioning.title:
when use_versioning is set to true file is saved with original name,
without unique suffix this option will override existing file and increment its version

v1FixInfo.description: Contains information about fix options. Provides a set of version strings representing releases where the vulnerability has been fixed. These versions may be higher (newer) or lower (older patched releases) than the vulnerable version range, indicating all known unaffected versions.
v1FixInfo.title: Fix Info

type.description: the package "type" or package "protocol" such as maven, npm, nuget, gem, pypi, etc.

namespace.description: a name prefix such as a Maven group id, a Docker image owner, a GitHub user or organization. Namespace is type-specific.

qualifiers.description: qualifier data for a package such as OS, architecture, repository, etc. Qualifiers are type-specific.

subpath.description: subpath within a package, relative to the package root.

totalCount.title: total number of matching items (if computed)

v1Report.description: A comprehensive security assessment report generated by Dolina ASPM after analyzing one or more scanner reports. It contains normalized findings, risk scores, severity classifications, remediation recommendations, and contextual metadata (e.g., affected components, code locations). This report provides a unified view of the application's security posture, enabling prioritization and tracking of vulnerabilities across the software development lifecycle.
v1Report.title: Report

v1Repository.description: Git repository configuration defining the source code origin for application revisions. Contains repository identification, clone URL, authentication details (masked), branch/tag defaults, and metadata for ASPM scanning and historical analysis.
v1Repository.title: Git repository

v1ScannerReport.description: A report generated by an external security scanner (e.g., Trivy, Semgrep, Snyk). It encapsulates raw findings, scan metadata (scanner name, version, timestamp), target information (repository, image, file path), and any additional context required for ingestion. This report serves as the primary input to Dolina ASPM for normalization, deduplication, and risk analysis.
v1ScannerReport.title: Scanner Report

v1Vendor.description: Vendor entity representing a software or service provider in the ASPM system. Includes identification details, name, description, external references, and audit timestamps for tracking vendor information.
v1Vendor.title: Vendor

v1VendorScoring.description: Vendor risk assessment and scoring model. Contains vendor identifier, computed security score, risk factors, assessment methodology details, and timestamps for score validity and updates.
v1VendorScoring.title: Vendor scoring

id.title: cve identification, for example CVE-2024-3094, GHSA-cxpw-2g23-2vgw

v1Vulnerability.description: Represents a standardized vulnerability entry from and Advisory (CVE, NVD or other). Contains core vulnerability metadata including CVE ID, description, publication date, severity scores (CVSS), affected components, and remediation information. Serves as the authoritative reference for tracking known security vulnerabilities in the Dolina ASPM system.
v1Vulnerability.title: Vulnerability
